en.html:
The <ruby>weather<rt>・・・</rt></ruby> was changing dramatically.

Just when the besiegers seemed unstoppable, on the verge of entering the castle, one airship appeared in the northeast. It swept aside the occupation dragoons sent to intercept it almost instantly and advanced above Fudaraku.

Under that extraordinary pressure, the enemy airship formation withdrew. Even the <ruby>fortress-class ship<rt>Galley Keep</rt></ruby> did not counterattack. Perhaps waiting to assess matters, it turned under dragoon escort.
en.text:
The weather・・・ was changing dramatically.

Just when the besiegers seemed unstoppable, on the verge of entering the castle, one airship appeared in the northeast. It swept aside the occupation dragoons sent to intercept it almost instantly and advanced above Fudaraku.

Under that extraordinary pressure, the enemy airship formation withdrew. Even the fortress-class shipGalley Keep did not counterattack. Perhaps waiting to assess matters, it turned under dragoon escort.

ja.html:
<ruby>空模様<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>が劇的な変化を遂げつつあった。

　攻城軍の強勢を留め得ず、もはや城内へ突入される
かと思えた時、北東の空に一隻の飛行艦が現れ……
　迎撃に出た進駐軍の竜騎兵隊をほとんど一瞬にして
薙ぎ払い、普陀楽上空へ進出する。

　その異様な圧力に、進駐軍側の飛行艦団は押され、
後退してゆく。
　<ruby>要塞級<rt>ガレーキープ</rt></ruby>さえ反攻しようとはしない。ひとまず様子を
見るつもりか、竜騎兵に守られながら艦首を返した。

en.html:
Its carrier units possessed abnormal fighting power.

That aerial engagement... details were indistinct from below. But it had been <ruby>sniping<rt>・・</rt></ruby>.

Matenkou’s units shot enemy armor down from a distance. Among next-generation <ruby>anti-armored-warrior shooting armaments<rt>ADSA</rt></ruby>, <ruby>high-velocity armor-piercing rounds<rt>HVAP</rt></ruby> were generally considered the most promising. These weapons were not those.

Too accurate, too powerful for that. Something else. Newer. More terrible.

もの……。

茶々丸の指が天空を差す。
　そこでは再び戦闘が繰り広げられていた。

　いや、果たして戦闘と呼んで良いものか。
　進駐軍の<ruby>殿軍<rt>しんがり</rt></ruby>に残った竜騎兵隊に食いつく篠川軍の

ただただ一方的に撃ち、墜としてゆく。

　更に正確さを期すなら、遊猟だ。

en.html:
A wretched sight.

The British Empire’s knights drew swords, leveled spears, charged bravely—and could not return even one cut. Mocking sniper fire struck them down with ease. They died to no purpose.

For that moment, I sympathized not with the allies who had saved us, but with our enemies. Shared the sorrow of those abandoned by time.

ja.html:
無惨な光景であった。

　剣を抜き、槍を構え、勇壮にも突進する大英帝国の
騎士たちは――わずか一太刀を報いる事さえ叶わない。
　嘲笑じみた狙撃を浴び、いとも容易く打ち倒され、
虚しくも死に絶えてゆく。

　その一瞬、俺は窮地を救ってくれた友軍ではなく、
敵である彼らの側に同調した。
　時の流れに置き捨てられた者の悲哀を共有した。

Chachamaru"The League is improving HVAP also. Deployment soon."

Kageaki"..."

Chachamaru"At the old age’s end. Create the final myth・・・・・."
Chachamaru"Just slipping in before closing, perhaps..."

Outside the castle also, the occupation forces began withdrawing.

Much of their offensive had depended on aerial superiority and bombing support. With that gone, reconsidering operations was natural.

Apparently we could buy time. The time we needed until <ruby>Silver Star<rt>Hikaru</rt></ruby> awoke.

城の外でも、進駐軍が撤退を開始していた。

　彼らのこれまでの攻勢は航空優越、つまり空爆支援
に支えられていた部分が大きい。
　それが失われた今、作戦を再考するのは当然だろう。

　俺達が必要とする、<ruby>銀星号<rt>ひかる</rt></ruby>が目覚めるまでの時間を。
